headline: Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir to be sworn in as 23rd President Friday evening
summary: The newly elected president will visit the graves of Ziaur Rahman and Khaleda Zia before taking the oath of office at Bangabhaban.
details: Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir will take the oath as the 23rd President of Bangladesh on Friday evening at Bangabhaban.
Before the swearing-in ceremony, he is scheduled to pay respects at the graves of former President Ziaur Rahman and former Prime Minister Begum Khaleda Zia at Zia Uddyan in the capital.
Following the tribute, the newly elected president will offer prayers and Fatiha for the departed leaders.
Mirza Fakhrul was elected as president on Thursday, August 20, by the members of Parliament. He secured 255 votes out of a total of 349 votes cast.
France and Switzerland have already extended their congratulations to the newly elected president.
caption:
Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir becomes the 23rd President of Bangladesh after securing 255 MP votes.

Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir will take the oath as the 23rd President of Bangladesh on Friday evening at Bangabhaban.

Before the swearing-in ceremony, he is scheduled to pay respects at the graves of former President Ziaur Rahman and former Prime Minister Begum Khaleda Zia at Zia Uddyan in the capital.

Following the tribute, the newly elected president will offer prayers and Fatiha for the departed leaders.

Mirza Fakhrul was elected as president on Thursday, August 20, by the members of Parliament. He secured 255 votes out of a total of 349 votes cast.

France and Switzerland have already extended their congratulations to the newly elected president.

headline_marked: 36 cases: [[RAB arrests top criminal Chua Salim]] in Geneva Camp
headline: 36 cases: RAB arrests top criminal Chua Salim in Geneva Camp
summary: The suspect, a notorious drug dealer and gang leader, was caught in a secret location in Mohammadpur with a pistol and ammunition.
details: Rapid Action Battalion (RAB-2) has arrested Mohammad Salim Ashrafi, better known as 'Chua Salim', a notorious criminal and drug dealer from Mohammadpur's Geneva Camp.

During a targeted operation based on intelligence, RAB-2 officers discovered Salim in a secret location within the camp. They recovered a pistol, two rounds of ammunition, and a quantity of narcotics from his possession.
According to RAB-2 Commander Naymul Hassan, Salim is linked to a drug syndicate and has been involved in various crimes, including murder and arms possession, in Geneva Camp and surrounding areas.
The suspect currently faces 36 separate legal cases involving murder, weapons, and drugs. He had previously been arrested by RAB-2 on January 8, 2025, but was later released on bail.
The RAB commander expressed frustration over the fact that such high-profile criminals are often granted bail, allowing them to continue their criminal activities.
